relation_proposals.evidence_context: The tutor's language model uses a decoder-only transformer to process text. A tokenizer divides an input passage into tokens, and an embedding layer maps those tokens to numerical vectors. Positional information helps the transformer distinguish sequences containing the same tokens in different orders. In each attention layer, self-attention combines information from token representations. A causal attention mask prevents a position from attending to later positions when the model predicts the next token. This restriction applies during both training and generation. Attention can connect information across a passage, but the model's finite context window limits the amount of text available in a single request. An attention weight does not establish that the associated claim is true.
